name: Should I DIY drywall taping and mudding or hire it out in the Denver area?
description: DIY is fine for small patches, but larger rooms, ceilings, or rough previous work usually justify hiring a pro for a cleaner finish.

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are comparing DIY versus hiring help in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, or Parker, the main question is whether you want to spend time learning the process or pay for a faster, more consistent finish.
